data.name: Black Powder Magic
data.detailed_description:
Black Powder Magic is a fast-paced 2D action roguelite where precision, timing, and smart decisions are the difference between survival and defeat.

On a distant planet consumed by the Infinite, you play as Kalewar, the Black Powder Mage, sent to uncover the truth behind a growing infestation. What begins as an investigation quickly turns into a relentless fight against escalating threats—and a final confrontation you must be prepared for.

Every run challenges you with dynamic objectives: survive overwhelming swarms, eliminate priority targets, and take down powerful bosses. But success isn’t just about firepower—it’s about how you fight.

TAKE CONTROL OF THE FIGHT

You are the weapon

No autopilot. No passive gameplay.

Aim your weapons, land skill-shot grenades, time your dashes, and unleash ultimates when it matters most. Every action is in your hands—and every mistake can cost you the run.

MASTER TRULY UNIQUE BUILDS

Your gear and choices define you

Your loadout shapes your playstyle—and nothing feels interchangeable.

Choose your weapon, grenade, and ultimate before each run, then enhance them through powerful upgrades. Weapons feature distinct mechanics to learn and master, grenades go far beyond simple explosives, and ultimates evolve into devastating abilities.

During a run, expand your build with upgradable passives and dash modifiers that can fundamentally change how you fight and move.

Discover synergies, experiment with combinations, and adapt to survive.

GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN

Die, adapt, come back stronger.

Each run rewards you with resources to unlock new weapons, abilities, and permanent upgrades. Invest in talents that significantly impact your playstyle, opening up new strategies and builds.

Start every run fresh—but never from scratch.

FIGHT ENEMIES THAT DEMAND STRATEGY

Everything is trying to kill you—just differently

Every enemy matters.

Face distinct enemy types:

  • Swarming mobs that pressure and surround

  • Powerful elites with dangerous abilities

  • Bosses designed as true skill checks

Different encounters demand different tactics. What works in one run—or one level—may fail in the next.

CHALLENGE THE RUN. CHALLENGE YOURSELF.

Each level introduces unique challenges that push your skill further—complete objectives like finishing a stage at full health or under specific conditions to prove true mastery.

Compete with your friends through Steam leaderboards and race for the best completion times on every level.

FEATURES

  • Skill-based 2D shooter combat with full player control

  • Deep roguelite progression with meaningful choices

  • Unique weapons, grenades, evolving ultimates, passives, and dash modifiers

  • Distinct enemies and challenging boss encounters

  • Level-specific challenges that increase replayability

  • Steam friend leaderboards for best completion times

  • High replayability through diverse builds and strategies

SURVIVE THE RUN

Adapt. Improve. Overcome.

The Infinite is spreading.
And it won’t stop unless you do.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 2 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 or equivalent
  • Storage: 305 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Expected framerate 30+ fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: OS Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Processor 3Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 or equivalent
  • Storage: 305 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Expected framerate 90+ fps
